title: azorella trifurcata var. rahmeri
intro: Azorella trifurcata var. rahmeri, commonly known as a type of South American plant, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Azorella trifurcata var. rahmeri include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, helping to protect cells from damage and promote healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
